ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 5-10% high-intensity (white) linear and focal disruptions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black base across both lobes. High-contrast white linear filaments are primarily concentrated on the central-left lobe. White focal clusters are located at the extreme lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with an approximate 50-60 degree pixel-calculated angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Notable large-amplitude concave notches located on the distal third of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward curve extending from the median notch to the lateral tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity white circular pixels (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter) located at the distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: High-contrast white linear pixel disruptions. Left lobe features approximately 6-8 vertically oriented streaks. Right lobe features fewer, shorter diagonal streaks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular indentation on the far-left trailing edge (lateral tip area) and visible calcified clusters on the far-right tip.
